about: Amanda L. Riddle is the managing partner of Corey, Luzaich, de Ghetaldi & Riddle LLP and focuses her practice on civil litigation, including general and complex business litigation, probate litigation, employment litigation and contract litigation. Currently, Ms. Riddle represents 130 victims of the Pacific Gas & Electric gas transmission line explosion that occurred on September 9, 2010, in San Bruno, California, killing eight people, injuring several others, and destroying 40 homes. The firm acts as co-liaison counsel for all Plaintiffs in this matter. Ms. Riddle also serves as First Vice President of the San Mateo County Trial Lawyers Association and serves on the board of directors of the San Mateo County Bar Association Women Lawyers Section.
